hero_subline: An association of holiday apartment hosts in the Bernese Oberland. We foster professional exchange among ourselves – and contribute constructively to the debate on fair rules for short-term rentals.
zitat: For over a year I've been a member of the Ferienwohnungsverein Jungfrau. The connections enrich me greatly. I'm glad that, as a member, I can actively help shape how the para-hotel sector is perceived.
